public_prediction.current_source_public_frame: full unmodified original emitted uint8 bytes, C-order in each engine original array shape
public_prediction.start_of_episode_history_sentinel: exact tagged sentinel distinct from genuine bytes, no wrap across episodes
public_prediction.next_public_target: one of 256 original next-public uint8 values at each byte position
public_prediction.output: per-position probability vector over exactly values 0..255, normalized and strictly positive
public_prediction.primary_loss: mean across byte positions of -ln P(actual next byte), then mean steps within episode; held reports equal-weight independent reset episode means

fixed_training_estimators.full_context_current: length-delimited exact ORIGINAL entire current frame bytes plus action
fixed_training_estimators.full_context_history: same full_context_current plus previous two original public frame bytes and announced actions, with explicit episode-boundary sentinel
fixed_training_estimators.copy_baseline: P(v)=0.90 if v is current byte plus 0.10/256; otherwise 0.10/256; equivalently 0.90*I[v=current]+0.10/256
fixed_training_estimators.training_method: exact complete counts over fixed training data, no optimizer, learning rate, epochs or local-search freedom

train_only_decision.reference_selection: minimum validation mean per-episode categorical NLL among prior-only, copy-baseline, full-current counts
train_only_decision.reference_trained_on: train_fit seeds only for validation comparison
train_only_decision.history_candidate: precommitted full-current plus exactly 2 prior public frames/action counts; no alternative history lengths
train_only_decision.preheld_stop_rule: If history validation per-episode mean categorical NLL >= selected current-only reference, STOP before any held-development episode.
train_only_decision.after_validation: Refit both history candidate and selected reference count prior on all 24 combined train-fit and train-validation reset seeds; fixed selection retained

prospective_held_dev_criteria.paired_cluster_bootstrap_method: sample 12 seed indices with replacement; recompute mean(D); sorted percentile lower endpoint at 2.5%; require >0

replay_and_cost.original_public_action_next_event_sha256: Windows x2, Linux x2; preserve original source independent SHA, clean worktrees
replay_and_cost.count_checkpoint_canonical_encoding: sorted context keys and value counts, exact original source identity; no Python dict iteration dependence
replay_and_cost.report: native original source generation and actor CPU, each predictor fit/eval CPU, OS RSS with shared-process caveat, count tables/checkpoint bytes, history bytes, communication bytes

governance.role: standalone narrowly scoped conventional public-history information test, not native 45-slot model qualification
